rules: not operationalisable: Needs traded volume on 15s/30s/1m bars of a volume-bearing (futures) instrument. Every XAUUSD file in the workspace (certified xau_m1_full.parquet and the others) carries open/high/low/close only - no volume or tick-count column - and has no sub-minute bars; spot gold is OTC with no exchange volume. 'Spike' is also never sized. Replacing volume with M1 range would test range expansion, a different concept, so no faithful operationalisation exists on this data.
